column1: # Independent semantic-state oracle. UTF8 hex, ~ = empty.
# Every context first consumes p, registers state=7 and existing portable extra label=before.
# A mutating emoji callback sets state=99, changes existing extra, and registers a related new node.
# MatchOnly restores semantic state even when inner consume/raw callbacks advance consumed.
# Resource and callback exceptions restore owned boundaries BEFORE close; resource failure stays sticky.
